4 zombified piglins, 8 magma blocks, 20 nether bricks, 16 gold ingots, 576 netherrack.

Every 4 seconds: gold nuggets (about 3) and a 7.5% gold ingot, as with Looting V.
guide.nexium.mobs.witherfarm:
Wither Skeleton Farm
4 wither skeletons, 16 nether brick fences, 8 soul sand, 4 coal blocks, 4 magma blocks, 576 netherrack.

Every 6 seconds: coal, bones and a 7.5% skull.
guide.nexium.mobs.shulkerfarm:
Shulker Farm
4 shulkers, 32 purpur blocks, 8 end rods, 8 ender pearls, 576 end stone bricks.

Every 30 seconds: a shulker shell about 4 times in 5.
guide.nexium.mobs.witchfarm:
Witch Farm
2 witches, 8 cauldrons, 16 spruce planks, 8 lily pads, 576 mossy cobblestone.

Every 10 seconds: a witch's own drops, as if a player killed her: glowstone dust, redstone, gunpowder, sugar, spider eyes, sticks and glass bottles.
guide.nexium.mobs.canefarm:
Sugar Cane Farm
32 sugar cane, 4 water buckets, 8 pistons, 16 observers, 576 sand.

3 sugar cane every 20 seconds.
guide.nexium.mobs.bamboofarm:
Bamboo Farm
32 bamboo, 4 water buckets, 8 pistons, 16 observers, 576 dirt.

4 bamboo every 20 seconds.
guide.nexium.mobs.wartfarm:
Nether Wart Farm
32 nether wart, 16 soul sand, 4 lava buckets, 8 magma blocks, 576 netherrack.

4 nether wart every 30 seconds.
guide.nexium.mobs.monsterfarm:
Monster Farm
1 zombie, 1 pillager, 8 hoppers, 16 iron bars, 8 pistons, 4 emerald blocks, 576 cobblestone.

Every 10 seconds: the real drops of a zombie, skeleton, spider, creeper, pillager, vindicator and evoker, as if a player killed each (no Looting): rotten flesh, bones, arrows, string, gunpowder, emeralds and more, all mixed. A Totem of Undying is a rare find: 2% of cycles.
guide.nexium.mobs.nethermobfarm:
Nether Mob Farm
1 blaze, 1 ghast, 1 magma cube, 16 nether bricks, 4 lava buckets, 8 magma blocks, 576 netherrack.

Every 10 seconds: a blaze's, a ghast's and a magma cube's drops, as if a player killed them: blaze rods, ghast tears, gunpowder and magma cream.
guide.nexium.mobs.oceanfarm:
Ocean Farm
1 guardian, 1 drowned, 1 cod, 16 prismarine bricks, 8 sea lanterns, 4 water buckets, 576 sand.

Every 10 seconds: their drops, as if a player killed them: prismarine shards and crystals, fish, rotten flesh, copper and more.
guide.nexium.mobs.slimefarm:
Slime Farm
2 slimes, 4 slime blocks, 8 sticky pistons, 8 hoppers, 576 mud.

Every 10 seconds: a small slime's drop, slime balls.
guide.nexium.mobs.livestockfarm:
Livestock Farm
1 each of cow, pig, sheep, chicken and rabbit, 16 hay bales, 16 oak fences, 576 dirt.

Every 20 seconds: the drops of a cow, a sheep (random colour), a chicken (and an egg), a pig and a rabbit.
guide.nexium.mobs.cropfarm:
Crop Farm
32 each of wheat, carrots, potatoes and beetroot, 4 water buckets, 576 dirt.

Every 20 seconds: 3 of each crop and a seed or two.
guide.nexium.mobs.gourdfarm:
Gourd and Cactus Farm
16 each of melons, pumpkins, cactus and kelp, 4 water buckets, 576 sand.

Every 20 seconds, all at once: 12 melon slices, 3 pumpkins, 4 cactus and 6 kelp.
guide.nexium.mobs.generatorfarm:
Generator
4 lava buckets, 4 water buckets, 8 hoppers, 2 diamond pickaxes, 576 cobblestone.

Every 10 seconds, by its mode button: 8 cobblestone, stone, gravel or sand, 4 clay or 2 basalt. Obsidian: 1 every 20 seconds.
guide.nexium.mobs.beefarm:
Bee Farm
2 bees, 4 beehives, 4 campfires, 16 flowers, 8 glass bottles, 576 oak planks.

Every 20 seconds: 1 to 3 honeycomb, and 2 bottles of honey, both into its output slots.
guide.nexium.mobs.mossfarm:
Moss Farm
32 moss blocks, 8 azaleas, 4 water buckets, 8 bone blocks, 576 clay.

Every 20 seconds: 3 moss blocks, 2 moss carpet, the same of pale moss (and 2 pale hanging moss), 6 resin clumps and a 10% azalea or flowering azalea.
guide.nexium.mobs.treefarm:
Tree Farm
18 stacks of logs (1,152 logs, any kinds), made at a Farm Assembler. Needs power: 10 NE/t.

Pick the tree with the mode button on its screen (shift-click goes back): oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, pale oak, poplar, crimson, warped or chorus.

Every 20 seconds: 8 logs of that tree (stems for crimson and warped). Chorus makes 4 chorus fruit and, 5% of the time, a chorus flower.
guide.nexium.mobs.xpfarm:
Experience Farm
64 Bottles o' Enchanting, made at a Farm Assembler. Needs power: 10 NE/t.

Makes 40 experience a second and keeps it, up to 200 levels' worth (149,720 points). It stops when full and starts again once you collect some.

Right-click it: Collect all gives you everything banked; +1 level and +10 levels give just enough to rise that many levels, or everything if there is less.

A redstone signal pauses it, and a comparator reads how full it is. Broken, it gives its experience back as orbs.
guide.nexium.mobs.froglightfarm:
Froglight Farm
3 temperate frogs, 3 warm frogs, 3 cold frogs, 9 slimes (all Captured Mobs), 576 glass of any colour.

Every 20 seconds: 5 ochre, 5 verdant and 5 pearlescent froglights.
guide.nexium.essentials.freezer:
Freezer
Fill it with water, by bucket or pipe, and it freezes ice: 1 bucket, 5 seconds each.

Its button picks ice, packed ice (9 buckets, 22.5 s) or blue ice (81 buckets, 45 s). Water is used up steadily. The OC button runs it x2, x4 or x8.

Hoppers below take the ice; item conduits can take it from any side.
guide.nexium.essentials.freezer2:
Dyeing
Dye a Freezer in the crafting grid like leather armor; dyes mix. Body and frame take the colour; frost, glow and water don't.

A cauldron of water washes it.

Packed ice crafts into 9 ice, blue ice into 9 packed ice.
guide.nexium.essentials.sand:
Soul sand to sand
A blast furnace smelts soul sand into sand, with no experience, at the speed of an ore.

The Piglin Barter Farm gives soul sand, so this turns a barter overflow into sand.
block.nexium.reinforced_glass.desc: Tinted glass that blocks light. The Wither, the Ender Dragon and explosions can't break it
guide.nexium.essentials.reinforced_glass:
Reinforced Glass
Tinted glass that nothing but you can break. It blocks light like tinted glass and drops itself with any tool, but the Wither, the Ender Dragon and every explosion (creepers, TNT, ghast fireballs, Wither skulls and end crystals) leave it standing.

Craft 8 from 8 glass around an obsidian block.
guide.nexium.note.planks: Planks and slabs of one wood
guide.nexium.note.next_size: Each size: 3 parts + gold, diamond, emerald, Nexium

guide.nexium.power.meter:
Power Meter
Put it against any Energy Conduit and right-click it: the dashboard shows what that whole conduit network makes and uses each tick, how much is stored in the conduits and batteries and how long it lasts, a minute of history, and every generator, machine and battery on it.

Each machine has a priority (High, Normal or Low) and an On/Off switch. When power runs short, Low machines go without first, so the Freezer can keep running while a farm waits. Off takes a block off the network without breaking the conduit's settings.

The numbers are for the last second and start again whenever any conduit is placed or broken.

guide.nexium.start.quests:
Quests
A quest book with six chapters: Storage, Power, Farms, Tools, Backpack and Nexium. Open it with the Quests button at the top of this Codex, or the Open Quests key (unbound until you pick one).

Each quest asks you to make or have something. It counts what you have already done, so nothing is repeated. Nothing is locked: every chapter is open from the start, in any order.

Every quest gives random items from the mod, more of them from the later chapters. No recipe is ever locked: every Nexium recipe is already in your recipe book.

guide.nexium.mobs.dog:
Zoe the Dog
A dog that follows you like a tamed wolf, goes down on the ground when you right-click her to sit, comes to you if you get far away, and fights what attacks you, biting 1.5 times as hard as a wolf.

Nothing in the world can kill her: mobs, falls, fire, lava, drowning and explosions all do nothing. Only the kill command and the void take her away. Creepers run from her and cannot blow up near her.
guide.nexium.mobs.dog2:
The Dog Egg
Craft it from 5 bones and 4 leather. Right-click a block to let her out, tame and with a green collar. Sneak + right-click her with an empty hand to put her back in the egg.

She wears Wolf Armor or the Nexium Dog Armor (6 Nexium Ingots, shaped like Wolf Armor): right-click her with it. Dye her collar as you would a wolf's.
